_doc: Copied from engineering/evidence/v3.36-prototype/results.json and engineering/prototypes/formalization-round/manifest.json (2026-10-12, F26-T7, AC6): per conjecture the words, the intent tests the prototype ended with (its seeds and every answered question; the values are its simulated proposer's), every mutant of human-ref with the prototype's result, and each candidate's provenance and expected outcome.
